candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assigning to a different variable (no effect on betLimit).
Set betLimit to amount plus one, changing resulting stored value after call.
Relax onlyOwner check to allow any caller (remove require), so AdjustBetAmounts can be called by non-owners and thus change betLimit for different callers (observable change in behavior).
Replace assignment to difficulty so AdjustDifficulty sets difficulty to amount + 1 instead of amount.
Replace assignment to difficulty so AdjustDifficulty sets difficulty to amount - 1 instead of amount (underflow prevented by Solidity 0.8 revert if amount is 0).
Replace body to set difficulty to a constant value 1, ignoring the provided amount.

Broaden onlyOwner() modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so AdjustDifficulty can be called by anyone and thus can change observable behavior by exposing different difficulty after calls by non-owners.
Replace assignment to difficulty so AdjustDifficulty increments the current difficulty by amount instead of setting it.
